player_prompt.intro:
Am ạdmi Player {player_id} menạ Kuhn Poker khelạrẹ tẹnạ {max_rounds} round khelạrẹ.
Khelạrẹ niyam:
- Kuhn Poker 3-card deck ạkhor J, Q, K ạkhor ạkhre (J sabse niche, K sabse upar)
- Pratyek player {ante} chip ạnte ạdmi 1 card pratyek round ạpạw (not kạrạb, card ạkhor bina pratisthapan, tẹnạ ạpnạ opponent ạkhor saman card ạkhor nahi pạw ạskte).
- Khelạrẹ {max_rounds} round tẹnạ chạlta rẹhẹ
- Sabse ạdhi chip ạkhor ạpnạr ạkhor sange jite
Kriya Niyam:
- '[check]': Bina bet ạkhor table ạpar pass kạr (kebạl bina bet ạkhor table ạpar)
- '[bet]': 1 chip pot ạkhor ạdd kạr (kebạl bina bet ạkhor table ạpar)
- '[call]': Virodhi ạkhor bet ạkhor 1 chip pot ạkhor ạdd kạr
- '[fold]': Ạpnạr ạkhor hạth ạkhor chor ạdmi virodhi ạkhor win pot ạkhor dene
